Some individuals excel after a lesson, while others may take longer to improve. I typically score in the 100s, took three lessons, and recorded scores of 90, 91, and 93 (or close to that). I thought I had it figured out. However, three rounds later, I shot a 125, my worst round ever.

When learning something entirely new, it can be challenging to maintain a swing that feels uncomfortable, making it easier to revert to old habits that feel familiar and comfortable.

Stay persistent, practice what your instructor teaches until it becomes more comfortable, and if they are a decent teacher, you should notice improvement soon. However, you can't expect to learn their teachings, skip practice, and play exceptionally right away. Some people do, but not everyone.

Keep pushing yourself, don’t give up, practice diligently, and I’ll be the first to celebrate your post when you achieve the best round of your life!
